credits.overview: Six college students meet at the final interview of a global IT company. credits.overview: A gutsy crew of Joseon pirates and bandits battle stormy waters, puzzling clues and militant rivals in search of royal gold lost at sea.

credits.title: The Accidental Detective
credits.overview: A cold-case enthusiast blogger and a washed-up veteran detective team up for a joint investigation to rescue their innocent friend who is framed for murder.

credits.title: Petty Romance
credits.overview: A comic artist and an unemployed sex columnist are trying to work together in order to win a lucrative comic-book competition.
